## Risk review

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible, security, privacy, permission, storage, or network changes.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, local configuration, signing material, or generated build output.
- [ ] I reviewed untrusted paths/input, shell arguments, logs, and failure behavior affected by this change.
- [ ] Dependency/native-runtime changes include source, license, version, digest, and provenance details (or are not applicable).
- [ ] I added an entry to `CHANGELOG.md` for a notable user-facing change (or it is not applicable).
- [ ] I reviewed and take responsibility for any AI-assisted changes and disclosed material assistance when relevant.
